_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

county_probate_court.label: County Probate Court
county_probate_court.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

docket_no.label: Docket No
avoid: a docket from another jurisdiction's format

respondent_name.label: Respondent Name
respondent_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

medical_professional_name.label: Medical Professional Name
medical_professional_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

professional_type.label: Professional Type
professional_type.expects: check only if the statement is true

office_address.label: Office Address
office_address.expects: an address with: street, city, state, zip
avoid: the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
a PO box where a physical/legal residence is required

professional_relationship_description.label: Professional Relationship Description
professional_relationship_description.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

last_exam_date.label: Last Exam Date
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields
